notes.title: Dark Life Excalibur: Blood, Action, Adrenaline and Bestiality.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44331618/fe27c55ccfd7f25eae15032b0e8c7cb5da756264.png[/img]

[h1]Add Dark Life Excalibur to your Wishlist![/h1]

[b]Dark Life: Excalibur[/b] is a [b]fantasy action adventure[/b] that tells the story of [b]Aron[/b], a human linked to the most famous and legendary sword of all time: [b]Excalibur[/b]. 

Aron must find peace through his family's vengeance and to do so he must discover why [b]York, the lord of the giants[/b], destroyed everything he fought for. To confront the beings that pursue him, he must[b] forge a sword capable of killing gods[/b], unaware that it would become[b] the most legendary sword of all time[/b], but also the one that has shed the most blood.

[previewyoutube=2vPl_Bm8Vbk;full][/previewyoutube]

In the world of Dark Life: Excalibur, [b]bestiality[/b] is a power that accumulates in the hearts of the beings that inhabit it. By killing enemies, you can accumulate bestiality in the form of fragments, which can be used to [b]buy upgrades, level up and improve parts of your Excalibur sword[/b] to build your own structure.

Each area will have a [b]final boss and mini bosses[/b] that are part of the story. Finishing them off is a necessary challenge to accomplish your goal. You will encounter puzzles as well as frantic combat and sometimes you will be overwhelmed by the [b]difficulty[/b] of certain enemies.

Don't forget to add it to your Wishlist on [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/10005129]PS5[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2323520/Dark_Life_Excalibur/]Steam[/url]!
